subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the combined tracker for reply metadata plus no-output UX, or should maintainers split it across the existing structured-reply and final-fallback tracks?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI, Gateway protocol, agent runtime context, and channel delivery semantics, and the existing open PR only covers one half.

options.title: Split Across Existing Tracks
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for reply metadata, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for final/no-output delivery semantics, and close this issue after both are represented.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface umbrella until both reply metadata and no-output UX land together.

options.title: Defer Reply Contract
options.body: Accept the current Markdown quote UI as sufficient for now and keep only the durable final-fallback track open.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Tracks
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for reply metadata, keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 for final/no-output delivery semantics, and close this issue after both are represented.

likelyOwner.reason: The current touched source and recent blame span both the Control UI send path and the runtime/outbound surfaces that need the contract decision.
